task: Implement build_index for the search engine without importing database index builder behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Search engine build_index constructs an inverted index over document tokens and writes it to disk.
Search index construction is batch-only; incremental updates use a delta merge, not a rebuild.
Index builds must be idempotent; re-running build_index with the same corpus overwrites cleanly.
When build_index appears in search and database contexts, verify the batch vs row-level model.
Database: build_index creates a B-tree or hash index on a table column using the storage engine.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: database B-tree index semantics are incompatible with inverted text index construction

candidate_memories.content: Old data note says index building should be unified so both systems use the same build_index API.
